ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate the central and lower regions, accounting for approximately 70-75% of the visible area, while low-intensity (black) pixels are concentrated along the trailing edges and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right Lobe: Exhibits a complex arrangement of parallel horizontal black striations and a prominent circular black spot (x:750, y:580 relative). Left Lobe: Features a large contiguous black patch on the upper distal quadrant and irregular mottling along the trailing edge. Both lobes have thick, solid black pigmentation boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; interior angle approximately 38 degrees; vertical depth relative to lobe tips is significant, though apex is partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks of 10-15 pixels). Left lobe trailing edge displays lower frequency, moderate-amplitude irregular undulations with several distinct shallow notches.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer lateral boundaries follow a convex mathematical curve, sweeping upward and outward to acute, tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete cluster of approximately three circular dark pixel spots on the lower right lobe. High-contrast white clusters (barnacle attachment points) visible on the dorsal-most black tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive set of parallel, horizontal linear disruptions (rake marks) localized to the medial region of the right lobe. Shorter, unaligned diagonal linear marks visible on the upper-left lateral margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme jaggedness and significant tissue loss along the right trailing edge, characterized by deep, irregular indentations indicative of major mechanical trauma or predation-related scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe features a unique, highly rhythmic parallel striation pattern resembling a fingerprint or comb, which is absent on the left lobe.
